const success = { type: 'turn.completed' };
const sources = [{ uri: 'https://example.org/frozen', text: 'Naïve ✓ 😀\nCaptured text.\n', observedAt: 'caller note', omissions: ['coverage unknown'] }];

const absent = path => access(path).then(() => false, () => true);
const alive = pid => { try { process.kill(pid, 0); return true; } catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ESRCH') return false; throw error; } };
const hash = text => createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
const partition = counts => assert.equal(counts.completed, Object.entries(counts).filter(([key]) => key !== 'completed').reduce((n, [, value]) => n + value, 0));
async function probe(name, scenario, body) {
  const fixture = await fakeCodex(scenario);
  await mkdir(join(fixture.home, 'codex-home'));
  process.env.CODEX_HOME = join(fixture.home, 'codex-home');
  await symlink(process.execPath, join(fixture.env.PATH, 'node'));
  const evidence = { name, scenario, environment: Object.fromEntries(['PATH', 'HOME', 'CODEX_HOME', 'TMPDIR'].map(key => [key, process.env[key]])) };
  try { evidence.result = await body(fixture); }
  finally {
    evidence.probes = await fixture.probes();
    evidence.invocation = await fixture.record().catch(() => null);
    if (evidence.invocation) {
      // macOS may inject its text-encoding variable below the spawn environment.
      const observedKeys = Object.keys(evidence.invocation.env).filter(key => !(process.platform === 'darwin' && key === '__CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING'));
      assert.deepEqual(observedKeys.sort(), ['CODEX_HOME', 'HOME', 'PATH', 'TMPDIR']);
      assert.equal(evidence.invocation.env.RESEARCH_AI_TEST_SECRET, undefined);
      assert.equal(evidence.invocation.env.PATH, fixture.env.PATH);
      assert.equal(evidence.invocation.env.CODEX_HOME, process.env.CODEX_HOME);
    }
    results.cases.push(evidence);
    await writeFile('consumer-results.json', JSON.stringify(results, null, 2) + '\n');
    await fixture.cleanup();
  }
}

const cli = args => {
  const result = spawnSync(bin, args, { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 10000, env: process.env });
  assert.equal(result.error, undefined);
  assert.equal(result.signal, null);
  return { args, status: result.status, stdout: result.stdout, stderr: result.stderr };
};
const investigationEvent = value => ({ events: [message(JSON.stringify(value)), success] });
await probe('portable-report-installed-api-and-cli', {}, async fixture => {
  const captured = [{ uri: 'https://example.org/policy', text: 'The service keeps logs for seven days.', observedAt: 'synthetic capture', omissions: ['No independent audit. <script>do not run</script>'] }];
  const basis = api.createEvidenceTable('Retention <review>', { sources: captured, columns: [{ id: 'retention', title: 'Retention', question: 'How long?' }] });
  const report = api.reviseReport(api.createReport(basis), { sectionId: 'retention', paragraphs: [{ text: 'Logs are kept for seven days.', citations: [{ source: 0, start: 0, end: captured[0].text.length, quote: captured[0].text }] }], gaps: ['Backup retention is absent.'] });
  const html = api.exportReportHtml(report);
  assert.equal(html, api.exportReportHtml(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(report))));
  assert.match(html, /href="#source-1"/);
  assert.match(html, /No independent audit/);
  assert.match(html, /Backup retention is absent/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(html, /<script\b/);
  const reportPath = join(fixture.root, 'portable-report.json');
  const htmlPath = join(fixture.root, 'portable-report.html');
  await writeFile(reportPath, JSON.stringify(report));
  await writeFile('portable-report.json', JSON.stringify(report, null, 2) + '\n');
  await writeFile('portable-report.html', html);
  const exporter = fileURLToPath(new URL('./node_modules/.bin/research-report-export', import.meta.url));
  const invoke = args => {
    const result = spawnSync(exporter, args, { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 10000, env: process.env });
    assert.equal(result.error, undefined);
    assert.equal(result.signal, null);
    return { status: result.status, stdout: result.stdout, stderr: result.stderr };
  };
  const stdout = invoke(['--input', reportPath]);
  assert.equal(stdout.status, 0, stdout.stderr);
  assert.equal(stdout.stdout, html);
  const created = invoke(['--input', reportPath, '--output', htmlPath]);
  assert.equal(created.status, 0, created.stderr);
  assert.equal(await readFile(htmlPath, 'utf8'), html);
  const overwrite = invoke(['--input', reportPath, '--output', htmlPath]);
  assert.equal(overwrite.status, 1);
  assert.match(overwrite.stderr, /EEXIST/);
  const invalid = structuredClone(report);
  invalid.basis.sources[0].text += 'changed';
  assert.throws(() => api.exportReportHtml(invalid), /invalid_report|outline|digest/i);
  await writeFile(reportPath, JSON.stringify(invalid));
  const refused = invoke(['--input', reportPath]);
  assert.equal(refused.status, 1);
  assert.equal(refused.stdout, '');
  assert.deepEqual(await fixture.probes(), []);
  assert.equal(await fixture.launched(), false);
  return { htmlSha256: createHash('sha256').update(html).digest('hex'), htmlBytes: Buffer.byteLength(html), stdoutMatchesApi: true, createOnly: true, invalidSourceRefused: true, nativeSessions: 0 };
});
await probe('mindmap-create-inspect-edit-export-reopen-and-explicit-draft', { events: [message(JSON.stringify({ rootLabel: 'Where does search run?', nodes: [
  { parent: -1, label: 'Files remain local', relation: 'elaborates', citations: [{ source: 0, start: 0, end: 37 }], gap: null },
  { parent: -1, label: 'Selected text goes to provider', relation: 'contrasts', citations: [{ source: 1, start: 0, end: 51 }], gap: null },
  { parent: 1, label: 'Retention unknown', relation: 'qualifies', citations: [], gap: 'Provider policy is absent.' },
] })), success] }, async fixture => {
  const captures = [
    { uri: 'https://example.org/local', text: 'Local search retains files on device.', observedAt: 'synthetic', omissions: ['Retention duration unknown.'] },
    { uri: 'https://example.org/cloud', text: 'Cloud indexing sends selected text to the provider.', omissions: ['Provider policy absent.'] },
  ];
  const child = (id, label, source) => ({ id, label, relation: 'elaborates', citations: [{ source, start: 0, end: captures[source].text.length, quote: captures[source].text }], gap: null, children: [] });
  const root = { id: 'root', label: 'Where does search run?', relation: null, citations: [], gap: null, children: [child('local', 'Files remain local', 0), { ...child('cloud', 'Text goes to provider', 1), relation: 'contrasts' },
    { id: 'gap', label: 'Retention unknown', relation: 'qualifies', citations: [], gap: 'Neither capture specifies duration.', children: [] }] };
  const map = api.createMindMap('Where does search run?', { sources: captures, root });
  const before = JSON.parse(api.renderMindMap(map, { format: 'tree' }));
  const inspected = map.root.children.flatMap(n => n.citations).map(c => map.sources[c.source].text.slice(c.start, c.end));
  assert.deepEqual(inspected, captures.map(s => s.text));
  const edited = api.reviseMindMap(map, { nodes: [{ id: 'local', label: 'Local search keeps files on device', citations: [{ source: 0, start: 0, end: 12, quote: 'Local search' }] }] });
  assert.equal(edited.origin.type, 'user-modified');
  const json = api.renderMindMap(edited, { format: 'json' });
  await writeFile('mindmap.json', json);
  const reopened = api.validateMindMap(JSON.parse(await readFile('mindmap.json', 'utf8')));
  assert.equal(api.renderMindMap(reopened, { format: 'json' }), json);
  assert.deepEqual(reopened.sources.map(({ sha256, ...s }) => s), captures);
  const after = JSON.parse(api.renderMindMap(reopened, { format: 'tree' }));
  assert.notEqual(after.contentSha256, before.contentSha256);
  await writeFile('mindmap-tree.json', api.renderMindMap(reopened, { format: 'tree' }));
  await writeFile('mindmap.md', api.renderMindMap(reopened));
  const cliExport = cli(['--mindmap-input', 'mindmap.json', '--mindmap-format', 'markdown']);
  assert.equal(cliExport.status, 0, cliExport.stderr);
  assert.equal(cliExport.stdout, api.renderMindMap(reopened));
  assert.deepEqual(await fixture.probes(), []);
  assert.equal(await fixture.launched(), false);
  const generated = await api.mindMapResearch('Where does search run?', { sources: captures, lease: fixture.lease, model: 'fixture-model' });
  assert.equal(generated.status, 'complete');
  assert.equal(generated.map.origin.type, 'model-generated');
  assert.equal(generated.receipt.outcome.cleanup.complete, true);
  return { inspected, before: before.contentSha256, after: after.contentSha256, originalsPreserved: true, origin: reopened.origin.type,
    tree: after, markdown: cliExport.stdout, nativeSessions: generated.receipt.outcome.nativeSessions };
});

for (const [name, events, exitCode, expectedStatus, failure] of [
  ['complete', [message(exact), success], 0, 'complete', undefined],
  ['partial', [message(exact), { type: 'turn.failed' }], 7, 'partial', 'runner_turn_failed'],
  ['failed', [{ type: 'error', message: 'Synthetic fatal failure' }], 3, 'failed', 'runner_protocol_error'],
]) {
  await probe(`cli-${name}`, { events, exitCode }, async fixture => {
    const result = cli(['--model', 'fixture-model', '--effort', 'high', 'Synthetic CLI question']);
    assert.equal(result.status, { complete: 0, partial: 2, failed: 1 }[expectedStatus]);
    assert.equal(result.stdout, expectedStatus === 'failed' ? '' : exact + '\n');
    const receipt = JSON.parse(result.stderr.trim().split('\n').at(-1));
    assert.equal(receipt.status, expectedStatus);
    assert.equal(receipt.failure, failure);
    assert.equal(receipt.termination.exitCode, exitCode);
    assert.deepEqual(receipt.cleanup, { complete: true, error: null });
    assert.equal(receipt.provider, null);
    assert.equal(receipt.model, 'fixture-model');
    assert.equal(receipt.effort, 'high');
    partition(receipt.actionCounts.messages);
    assert.equal((await fixture.probes()).length, 4);
    return { ...result, receipt };
  });
}
await probe('esm-readiness', {}, async fixture => {

  assert.equal(readiness.available, true);
  assert.equal(await fixture.launched(), false);
  return readiness;
});
for (const [name, tail, code, status, failure] of [
  ['complete', [success], 0, 'complete', undefined],
  ['partial', [{ type: 'turn.failed' }], 2, 'partial', 'runner_turn_failed'],
  ['fatal', [{ type: 'error', message: 'Synthetic fatal' }], 3, 'partial', 'runner_protocol_error'],
  ['nonzero', [success], 7, 'partial', 'runner_failed'],
]) {
  await probe(`esm-frozen-${name}`, { events: [message(exact), ...tail], exitCode: code }, async fixture => {
    const result = await run(fixture, { sources });
    assert.equal(result.status, status);
    assert.equal(result.answer, exact);
    assert.equal(result.receipt.failure, failure);
    assert.equal(result.receipt.termination.exitCode, code);
    assert.equal(result.receipt.termination.signal, null);
    assert.equal(result.receipt.provider, null);
    assert.equal(result.receipt.model, 'fixture-model');
    assert.equal(result.receipt.effort, 'high');
    assert.equal(result.receipt.nativeSessions, 1);
    assert.deepEqual(result.receipt.cleanup, { complete: true, error: null });
    assert.equal(result.receipt.mode, 'frozen');
    assert.deepEqual(result.receipt.source, sources.map(({ text, ...metadata }) => ({ ...metadata, sha256: hash(text) })));
    partition(result.receipt.actionCounts.messages);
    assert.equal(result.receipt.actionCounts.messages.checkpointed, 1);
    assert.equal(await absent(fixture.lease), true);
    assert.ok((await fixture.record()).args.includes('web_search="disabled"'));
    return result;
  });
}
await probe('esm-cancelled', { events: [message(exact), success], hang: true }, async fixture => {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const result = await run(fixture, { signal: controller.signal, onCheckpoint: () => { setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 20); } });
  assert.equal(result.status, 'partial');
  assert.equal(result.answer, exact);
  assert.equal(result.receipt.failure, 'cancelled');
  assert.equal(result.receipt.termination.trigger, 'request_aborted');
  assert.equal(result.receipt.termination.signal, 'SIGKILL');
  assert.deepEqual(result.receipt.cleanup, { complete: true, error: null });
  return result;
});

});
await probe('legacy-missing-cleanup', { events: [message(exact), success] }, async fixture => {
  const outcome = await lower(fixture, ws => ws.run(options));
  assert.equal(api.sessionCompleted(outcome), true);
  const legacy = structuredClone(outcome);
  delete legacy.cleanup;
  const historical = JSON.stringify(legacy);
  assert.equal(api.sessionCompleted(legacy), false);
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(legacy), historical);
  assert.equal('cleanup' in legacy, false);
  // A synthetic historical saved receipt remains readable without inventing cleanup.
  const saved = JSON.stringify({ status: 'complete', answer: exact, receipt: {
    profile: 'quick', model: 'historical', effort: 'historical', provider: null,
    termination: outcome.termination, terminal: outcome.terminal,
  } }) + '\n';
  await writeFile('historical-receipt.json', saved);
  const historicalResult = JSON.parse(await readFile('historical-receipt.json', 'utf8'));
  assert.equal('cleanup' in historicalResult.receipt, false);
  assert.equal(api.sessionCompleted({ ...outcome, cleanup: historicalResult.receipt.cleanup }), false);
  assert.equal(await readFile('historical-receipt.json', 'utf8'), saved);
  return { legacy, unchangedHistoricalBytes: historical, completed: api.sessionCompleted(legacy),
    historicalReceipt: historicalResult, historicalCleanup: 'unconfirmed', savedReceiptSha256: hash(saved) };
});
async function inject(fixture, text) {
  const executable = join(fixture.env.PATH, 'codex');
  const original = await readFile(executable, 'utf8');
  const marker = "process.stdin.on('end', () => {";
  assert.ok(original.includes(marker));
  await writeFile(executable, original.replace(marker, marker + text));
}
for (const exitCode of [0, 7]) {
  await probe(`descendant-exit-${exitCode}`, { events: [message(exact), success], exitCode }, async fixture => {
    await inject(fixture, `
      const descendant = require('node:child_process').spawn(process.execPath,
        ['-e', 'setInterval(() => {}, 1000)'], { stdio: 'ignore' });
      descendant.unref();
      writeFileSync(join(home, 'owned.json'), JSON.stringify({ pid: descendant.pid, leader: process.pid }));`);
    let owned;
    try {
      let boundary;
      const outcome = await lower(fixture, async ws => {
        const outcome = await ws.run(options);
        owned = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(fixture.home, 'owned.json'), 'utf8'));
        boundary = { leasePresent: !await absent(fixture.lease), descendantAlive: alive(owned.pid), cleanup: outcome.cleanup, owned };
        assert.equal(boundary.leasePresent, true);
        assert.equal(boundary.descendantAlive, false);
        assert.deepEqual(outcome.cleanup, { complete: true, error: null });
        return outcome;
      });
      assert.equal(outcome.termination.exitCode, exitCode);
      assert.equal(api.sessionCompleted(outcome), exitCode === 0);
      assert.equal(outcome.readable.text, exact);
      assert.equal(await absent(fixture.lease), true);
      return { outcome, boundary, leaseRemovedAfterCallback: true };
    } finally {
      owned ??= JSON.parse(await readFile(join(fixture.home, 'owned.json'), 'utf8').catch(() => '{}'));
      if (owned.pid && alive(owned.pid)) process.kill(-owned.leader, 'SIGKILL');
      if (owned.pid) for (let i = 0; i < 200 && alive(owned.pid); i++) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
      if (owned.pid) assert.equal(alive(owned.pid), false);
    }
  });
}
await probe('denied-live-leader', { events: [message(exact)], hang: true }, async fixture => {
  await inject(fixture, `writeFileSync(join(home, 'owned.json'), JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid }));`);
  const originalKill = process.kill, controller = new AbortController();
  let leader, directory, safety, fallbackUsed = false, ready;
  const barrier = new Promise(resolve => { ready = resolve; });
  try {
    process.kill = (pid, signal) => {
      if (pid === -leader && signal === 'SIGKILL') throw Object.assign(new Error('synthetic owned-group denial'), { code: 'EPERM' });
      return originalKill(pid, signal);
    };
    const pending = lower(fixture, async ws => {
      directory = ws.directory;
      return ws.run({ ...options, signal: controller.signal,
        onCheckpoint: () => { leader = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(fixture.home, 'owned.json'), 'utf8')).pid; ready(); } });
    });
    await barrier;
    safety = setTimeout(() => { fallbackUsed = true; try { originalKill(-leader, 'SIGKILL'); } catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ESRCH') throw error; } }, 3500);
    controller.abort();
    const outcome = await pending;
    assert.equal(fallbackUsed, false);
    assert.equal(api.sessionCompleted(outcome), false);
    assert.equal(outcome.failureReason, 'cancelled');
    assert.equal(outcome.readable.text, exact);
    assert.deepEqual(outcome.cleanup, { complete: false, error: 'process_group_cleanup_failed' });
    assert.equal(outcome.termination.exitCode, null);
    assert.equal(outcome.termination.signal, null);
    assert.equal(alive(leader), true);
    assert.equal(await absent(fixture.lease), false);
    assert.equal(await absent(directory), false);
    const ownership = await readFile(join(fixture.lease, 'owner.json'), 'utf8');
    assert.equal(JSON.parse(ownership).processGroupId, leader);
    const snapshot = JSON.stringify(outcome);
    process.kill = originalKill;
    originalKill(-leader, 'SIGKILL');
    for (let i = 0; i < 200 && alive(leader); i++) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
    assert.equal(alive(leader), false);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(outcome), snapshot);
    assert.equal(await readFile(join(fixture.lease, 'owner.json'), 'utf8'), ownership);
    return { outcome, retainedOwnership: JSON.parse(ownership), leaseRetainedAfterLateExit: true, fallbackUsed };
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(safety);
    process.kill = originalKill;
    controller.abort();
    leader ??= JSON.parse(await readFile(join(fixture.home, 'owned.json'), 'utf8').catch(() => '{}')).pid;
    if (leader && alive(leader)) originalKill(-leader, 'SIGKILL');
    if (leader) for (let i = 0; i < 200 && alive(leader); i++) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
    if (leader) assert.equal(alive(leader), false);
    if (directory) await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});
